# PRD: Crews body-canonical enforcement for review-surfacing kind tags

*Generated by Phase 2 PRD subagent of `/implement-with-ralph --from-plan --autonomous` on 2026-05-28. Source plan: `.ralph/jobs/crews-envelope-body-canonical-for-all-kinds/plan.md`.*

## 1. Introduction / Overview

The crews protocol currently permits a member to stuff substantive content into the `summary="..."` attribute of a `<|report kind=...|>` tag and leave the prose body as a stub. When that happens, the durable audit trail in `outbox.jsonl` / `mailbox-history.jsonl` captures only the stub (the `message` field is `tags.body`, not `tags.summary`), so the bookkeeper lead loses any searchable record of what the member actually reported.

This work codifies and enforces the rule **"for review-surfacing kinds (`done`, `question`, `blocked`), the prose body is canonical; the `summary` attribute is quick-look only"** at two layers in the `crews` plugin (lives in sibling repo `D:/ai-developer-toolkit/plugins/crews/`):

1. **Docs/briefing** — clarify the rule in SessionStart briefing, `CLAUDE.md`, `README.md`, and a new `docs/protocol.md`.
2. **Enforcement** — add a Stop-hook hard-block that fires when `tags.kind ∈ {done, question, blocked}` AND `summary.length > 200` AND `body.length < 50`. Thresholds are env-overridable; `kind=progress` is unconditionally exempt; `stop_hook_active=true` is a retry safety-valve (allows the turn through but logs the violation).

Ships as crews **v1.8.0** (minor — new Stop-hook block path).

## 2. Goals

- Hard-block lazy-summary envelopes at Stop-hook time for the three review-surfacing kinds.
- Preserve audit-trail integrity (no silent rewriting of `message`).
- Exempt `kind=progress` unconditionally (matches v1.6.0 review-required exemption).
- Provide an `stop_hook_active`-driven safety-valve so a stuck member cannot infinite-loop on the gate.
- Document the rule clearly enough that members get it right on the first turn.
- Maintain parity with the v1.6.2 listener-arm gate (`bumpBlockCount`, `appendLog` marker, `decision: 'block'` JSON contract).

## 3. User Stories

### US-001: Add detectLazySummary helper + canonical constants
**Description:** As a crews-plugin maintainer, I want a pure helper that detects lazy-summary envelopes so the Stop hook can hard-block them.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `hooks/protocol/report-tags.js` exports `detectLazySummary(tags, opts)`, `BODY_CANONICAL_KINDS` (frozen `['done', 'question', 'blocked']`), and `DEFAULT_BODY_CANONICAL_THRESHOLDS` (`{ summaryLimit: 200, bodyFloor: 50 }`).
- [ ] `detectLazySummary` returns `null` when not triggered, or `{ summaryLen, bodyLen, threshold }` when triggered (summary length > summaryLimit AND body length < bodyFloor AND kind ∈ BODY_CANONICAL_KINDS).
- [ ] `kind=progress` always returns `null` regardless of thresholds.
- [ ] Opts merge with defaults; missing opts use `DEFAULT_BODY_CANONICAL_THRESHOLDS`.
- [ ] Unit tests in `tests/protocol-report-tags.test.js` cover threshold boundaries (at-limit, +/-1 char, kind-exempt, opts-override).
- [ ] `node tests/run.js protocol-report-tags.test.js` exits 0.

### US-002: Wire the body-canonical gate into hooks/stop.js
**Description:** As a crews-plugin maintainer, I want the Stop hook to hard-block lazy-summary envelopes for review-surfacing kinds with a retry safety-valve.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `hooks/stop.js` requires `{ detectLazySummary, BODY_CANONICAL_KINDS, DEFAULT_BODY_CANONICAL_THRESHOLDS }` directly from `./protocol/report-tags` (mirrors the `parseTurnTags` pattern).
- [ ] Gate placed AFTER `parseTurnTags()`, AFTER the missing-kind block, AFTER the consumed-inbox eval, and BEFORE `decideStopBlock()` (the listener-arm gate).
- [ ] Env vars honored: `CREWS_BODY_CANONICAL` (set to `off` to disable entirely), `CREWS_BODY_CANONICAL_SUMMARY_CAP` (numeric override), `CREWS_BODY_CANONICAL_BODY_FLOOR` (numeric override).
- [ ] On detection AND `data.stop_hook_active !== true`: call `bumpBlockCount(state.name, crew, cwd, state.role, 'body not canonical')`; call `appendLog` with a line containing the literal substring `body-canonical: block`; write `{ decision: 'block', reason: <actionable text> }` to stdout; return.
- [ ] On detection AND `data.stop_hook_active === true`: call `appendLog` with a line containing the literal substring `body-canonical: bypassed-on-retry`; do NOT block; fall through to the remaining gates.
- [ ] Block `reason` text instructs the member to move substantive content from `summary` into the prose above the tag, and includes a brief example.
- [ ] No `outbox.jsonl` row is written when blocked (verified by reading the file after a blocked fixture).
- [ ] `node tests/run.js stop-decision.test.js` still green (existing listener-arm gate unchanged).

### US-002b: Extend runStop test harness for stop_hook_active
**Description:** As a test author, I want `runStop` to accept an optional `stopHookActive` flag so retry-path fixtures can exercise the safety-valve branch.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `tests/lib/force-response.js::runStop` accepts an optional parameter that, when truthy, sets `stop_hook_active: true` in the Stop-hook JSON input.
- [ ] Default behavior unchanged when the parameter is omitted; all existing call sites still pass.
- [ ] `node tests/run.js stop-decision.test.js` still green.

## 4. Functional Requirements

- FR-1: A pure helper `detectLazySummary(tags, opts)` lives in `hooks/protocol/report-tags.js`, returning `null` (no block) or `{ summaryLen, bodyLen, threshold }` (block).
- FR-2: `BODY_CANONICAL_KINDS` is a frozen array `['done', 'question', 'blocked']` exported from the same file.
- FR-3: `DEFAULT_BODY_CANONICAL_THRESHOLDS = { summaryLimit: 200, bodyFloor: 50 }` is also exported.
- FR-4: The Stop hook hard-blocks when the helper returns non-null AND `stop_hook_active !== true`, calling `bumpBlockCount(..., 'body not canonical')` first and writing `{ decision: 'block', reason }` to stdout.
- FR-5: When `stop_hook_active === true`, the gate logs `body-canonical: bypassed-on-retry` via `appendLog` and falls through.
- FR-6: When `CREWS_BODY_CANONICAL=off`, the gate is fully skipped (no detection, no log).
- FR-7: `CREWS_BODY_CANONICAL_SUMMARY_CAP` and `CREWS_BODY_CANONICAL_BODY_FLOOR` env vars override the defaults (parsed as integers; invalid values fall back to defaults).
- FR-8: `kind=progress` is unconditionally exempt — even adversarial env thresholds cannot trigger a block.
- FR-9: SessionStart briefing footer-tag section explicitly states the rule and threshold defaults.
- FR-10: `docs/protocol.md` is the canonical reference doc; `CLAUDE.md` and `README.md` link to it.
- FR-11: Version pinned to 1.8.0 across all manifests via `scripts/bump-version.js`.

## 5. Non-Goals (Out of Scope)

- Silent auto-promotion of `summary` into `body` (option D from plan; rejected — violates audit-trail integrity).
- Non-blocking warn-only mode (option B from plan; rejected — stderr unreliable across engines).
- Enforcement for `kind=progress` (explicitly exempt; revisit only if operator surfaces a use case).
- Any changes to `appendOutbox`, `parseTurnTags`, or `synthesizeSummary` (the helper is new; parser unchanged).
- Lead-side review-mail rendering changes (the v1.7.3 consumer-side fallback already shipped; this work is producer-side discipline).
- Pushing to remotes other than `origin` and `work`; force-pushing under any circumstance without explicit operator approval.

## 6. Design Considerations

- **Briefing prose budget.** The footer-tag section is already long; the new bullet stays terse and links to `docs/protocol.md` for prose.
- **Block reason readability.** Members read the block reason mid-turn and must self-correct on the next attempt; the text is one short paragraph plus an inline example (one good vs one bad tag).
- **Log marker consistency.** The literal substring `body-canonical` appears in both block and retry-allow log lines so tests can grep-assert presence/absence.

## 7. Technical Considerations

- **Sibling-repo worktree.** All code edits live in `D:/ai-developer-toolkit/.worktrees/crews-envelope-body-canonical-for-all-kinds/plugins/crews/` (worktree of the `ai-developer-toolkit` repo on branch `ralph/crews-envelope-body-canonical-for-all-kinds`). Job-state and bookkeeping live in this repo (`D:/harness-efforts/codexu/.ralph/jobs/...`). The `repoDir` field in `prd.json` points to the sibling-repo worktree, not codexu.
- **Test runner.** Custom Node runner at `plugins/crews/tests/run.js`. Pattern: `setupForceResponse({ prefix: 'crews-...', messages: [], ... })`, `writeTranscript`, `runStop`, `parseStopDecision`. Mirror `tests/stop-decision.test.js` structure.
- **Stop-hook block contract.** Single JSON object to stdout with `{ decision: 'block', reason }`. The v1.6.2 listener-arm gate is the precedent.
- **`bumpBlockCount` parity.** Every existing Stop hard-block path calls `bumpBlockCount(state.name, crew, cwd, state.role, '<reason>')` before writing the decision; the new gate must do the same with `'body not canonical'` so the v1.4.x circuit-breaker remains consistent.
- **Copilot mirror.** `hooks/copilot-stop.js` delegates to `hooks/stop.js` and `hooks/copilot-session-start.js` shares the briefing template — one implementation covers both engines.
- **Version-bump script.** `scripts/bump-version.js` pins all version-bearing files in lockstep. Manual edits risk skew that `tests/version.test.js` will catch loudly.

## 8. Success Metrics

- A lazy-summary `kind=question` turn (summary > 200, body < 50) hard-blocks at Stop time on first attempt, allowing the member to retry with the content moved into the body. Audit trail (`outbox.jsonl`) records the corrected envelope, not the stub.
- A legitimate ack-only short turn (summary < 200, body < 50, kind=done) is NOT blocked. False-positive rate target: zero in the integration test suite.
- A `kind=progress` envelope with any summary/body shape is NOT blocked. Verified by adversarial-threshold Fixture D2.
- A member that hits the block and retries (Claude/Copilot sets `stop_hook_active=true` on the second invocation) is allowed through with a logged audit marker. No infinite block loops.
- Full `node tests/run.js` exits 0 with the new fixtures included; existing tests unchanged.

## 9. Open Questions

- **Threshold tuning.** Defaults 200/50 inferred from the reproducer (600/55) and existing briefing soft cap (~120). Operator may tune via env vars in production without a code change.
- **Progress enforcement opt-in.** Not in scope; would require a separate `CREWS_BODY_CANONICAL_PROGRESS=on` flag if ever needed.
- **`stop_hook_active` semantics stability.** Confirmed via the existing v1.6.2 listener-arm gate; if Claude Code / Copilot ever changes the field shape, the new gate must follow whatever the existing gate does.
